messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@1166065212537970722> checked it, you're right, it's real. every hour 0.1% of each province's elderly die of old age, and your provinces are ~35% elderly. since the rebalance your growth is ~808k/h for the whole nation, split by cities/land, so the capital only gets ~79k/h of it. meanwhile ~298k elderly die there every hour, so it's about -218k/h net. that's your 860M → 857M. the whole nation is around -240k/h right now (808k growth vs ~1.05M old-age deaths). not a bug in your nation, it's how the two ticks add up for very big pops
